title: BlackboardObservation.v1
description: An OBSERVATION entry: a factual statement a worker extracted from a source. PROVENANCE IS MANDATORY — source_refs is required and non-empty (minItems 1): an observation with no source is rejected, because a sourceless claim can never be reconciled or promoted by Baltor. confidence records the worker's calibrated belief but is evidence, not authority. The matching BlackboardEntry row (kind=observation) carries serves_truth=false; an observation is candidate working state, never served truth.

entry_id.description: id of the BlackboardEntry (kind=observation) this body belongs to

blackboard_id.description: the blackboard this observation belongs to

statement.description: the factual statement extracted from the source(s)

source_refs.description: BlackboardSourceRef ids backing this observation — REQUIRED and non-empty; a sourceless observation is rejected

confidence.description: the worker's calibrated confidence in the statement (evidence, not authority)
